question: Thiruvathira is a cultural festival of which of the following Indian states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​The cultural festival Thiruvathira is celebrated in the Indian state of **Kerala**.
 
• It is a unique dance performed by women seeking blessings for marital bliss on **Lord Shiva's** birthday in the month of **Dhanu**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi currently confers classical status on eight Indian classical dance styles:-

 
 
• Bharatanatyam (Tamil Nadu)
 
• Kathak (North, West and Central India)
 
• Kathakali (Kerala)
 
• Kuchipudi (Andhra Pradesh)
 
• Odissi (Orissa)
 
• Manipuri (Manipur)
 
• Mohiniyattam (Kerala)
 
• Sattriya (Assam)
 
 
 
• Where as Ministry Of Culture includes Chhau also in the list and according to Ministry Of Culture's list therea are 9 classical Dance in India.
